title: Mexico City bank money in Bernard Barker's pocket traced to casino skim

tellings.quote: assassination wow because that bank account where those monies came out of where those bills were in Bernard Barker's pocket was in the bank account of this lawyer by the name of agario

plain: The bills found in the pocket of Bernard Barker, one of the men arrested in the 1972 Watergate break-in, came out of a Mexico City bank account belonging to a lawyer Sheehan calls 'Agario', and that money traces back to cash skimmed from casinos. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells Michels this without naming a source, and ties it to the New Orleans mob boss Carlos Marcello and, in his telling, to an assassination. If true, it would connect Watergate money to organised crime money.
